source_paper.citation: Jaruszewicz-Blonska et al., PLOS ONE, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0286416

paper_claims.A: damped nuclear NF-kB oscillations converging to the tonic-TNF steady state

source_paper.paper_phase_plane: free nuclear NF-kappaB versus free cytoplasmic IkappaBalpha

numeric_noise_floor.definition: 1000 * machine_epsilon * max(1, max(abs(y))) for each trajectory
numeric_noise_floor.role: exclude floating-point-scale pseudo-extrema only; not a biological amplitude threshold

extrema_rule.window: strictly after tonic TNF onset at t=1 h through the frozen case endpoint
extrema_rule.method: use sign changes in first differences on the captured raw plotted trajectory; discard only excursions whose peak-to-trough amplitude is at or below the numeric_noise_floor
extrema_rule.minimum_for_evaluation: at least two complete peak-to-trough oscillation amplitudes; otherwise INDETERMINATE

FIG8A_NOMINAL_DAMPED.rule: PASS only if every evaluable successive complete oscillation amplitude is strictly smaller than its predecessor. If amplitudes increase, FAIL_NATIVE_BEHAVIOR. If too few complete cycles exist, INDETERMINATE.
FIG8A_NOMINAL_DAMPED.claim_limit: finite-window morphology only; does not independently prove asymptotic stability

FIG8B_LIMIT_CYCLE.rule: PASS if at least two complete oscillation amplitudes survive the numerical floor and the full evaluable amplitude sequence is not strictly decreasing to the endpoint. Otherwise FAIL_NATIVE_BEHAVIOR or INDETERMINATE if insufficient cycles.
FIG8B_LIMIT_CYCLE.claim_limit: a finite 30 h trajectory cannot by itself prove a mathematically stable limit cycle; stable-limit-cycle topology remains a separate preregistered stability gate

FIG8C_RELAXATION_OSCILLATION.rule: Apply the same sustained-oscillation compatibility rule as FIG8B to nuclear NF-kB. Record the relaxation-like/spiky morphology claim separately as NOT_QUANTITATIVELY_ADJUDICATED because the paper supplies no numerical threshold and this freeze forbids inventing one after seeing the trajectory.
FIG8C_RELAXATION_OSCILLATION.claim_limit: periodicity may be evaluated; relaxation-like morphology is explicitly refused at this gate rather than post-hoc thresholded

required_outputs: finite-window adjudication PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE for each case
explicit separate status for the Figure 8C relaxation-like morphology claim
next_gate_if_native_behavior_is_compatib: Freeze a separate equilibrium/local-stability and representation-sensitivity analysis before computing Jacobian poles or asking whether a coherent chi_bio coordinate exists.
forbidden_inference: No result from this adjudication licenses chi_bio, Chi_bio, Bio Chi, a universal biological damping boundary, or a stable-limit-cycle claim beyond the finite-window evidence.
